title: Hot Inflation Just Hit Your AI Stocks. (Watch This Now)
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Despite a hot PPI the 10-year gapped down hard; he thinks the top in the 10-year is in and markets believe inflation is under control.
Falling rates should lift homebuilders, mortgage lenders, regional banks, consumer discretionary, travel and airlines; value plays are not the worst idea.
Major put walls held and semis breadth improved, so an oversold bounce and base-building is likely, though not out of the woods.
A cut from $2T to $1.5T is actually good news because it shows real demand exists for the IPO.

calls.condition: Needs to hold the put wall and get back over the 55-day moving average to build a base and rally
calls.reason: Hot PPI drove price down to the 765 put wall and 55-day MA, an undercut that reversed perfectly; expects base-building rather than a V.
calls.quote: if you hold here, which it looks to me like you have a really good shot of holding, you have nothing but time

calls.reason: 4-hour RSI around 15 signalled an oversold bounce; undercut and reclaim of the 55-day with a gap fill and divergences.
calls.quote: It was like at a 15 on the 4-hour in the NQ. So you knew that you were due for some kind of oversold bounce

calls.reason: Proprietary semis breadth indicator improved to flat after the OpenAI-day sell signal; semis held put walls; he bought semis broadly and sold puts.
calls.quote: I already started buying some semis today, mostly selling puts, but I did buy semis broadly

calls.reason: Micron got back over its ~900 put wall and stayed there on heavy buying with clear divergences.
calls.quote: the way that we acted today on Micron, it was really impressive how you got over that call or over that put wall and you stayed over it

calls.reason: Bounced perfectly off the 150 put wall on the highest volume since August, similar to prior bottoms; 38.2% retrace ~165 is a first tiring point.
calls.quote: So maybe 165 you could get to before you'd have to concern yourself

calls.reason: A ~$150M block trade bought at the 350 level shows someone wants to own it there.
calls.quote: somebody wants to own it at that level and I think that's important

calls.reason: Crude broke out; he saw it as a perfect entry with the 22-day MA as a stop (did not take it).
calls.quote: you broke out right here and I'm like, you know what? This is actually perfect spot to get involved and then you're just using that 22 as a stop

calls.reason: The 10-year gapped down hard after a hot PPI; a move that size takes billions and is sustainable.
calls.quote: So it's very clear that top on the 10 year is in

calls.reason: Homebuilders sit on the 200-week MA with a daily divergence; falling yields mean lower mortgages; many trade under tangible book value. Also likes NAIL.
calls.quote: the home builders will start to get a bid here because they start looking out like 18 months to 2 years

calls.reason: Regional banks setting up as interest-rate sensitive plays; he bought DPST today.
calls.quote: things like DPST had a good day. I own this. I We bought it today

calls.reason: Berkshire deploying cash aggressively like an 800-lb gorilla; chart keeps making higher highs.
calls.quote: you have the higher high. So this continues to lift

calls.reason: Hitting another high despite naysayers; biotech rotation ahead of an event in two weeks.
calls.quote: MRNA, I keep hearing like all the naysayers, meanwhile you're hitting another high on this. It's just been an absolute monster trade

calls.reason: Held up well right at its 1600 put wall; he sold puts on it.
calls.quote: ASML held up very well right against its put wall today at 1600. I sold puts on that. I really like the action today

notes: Date inferred as Thu 2026-10-15 from 'get you through tomorrow with the OpEx' (Oct 16 is monthly OpEx) and same-day PPI; listing approx_date is 10-16. 765 put wall assumed SPY (matches Verified Investing's 766 SPY support); the Nasdaq 55-day reference had no level. The '900 put wall' attributed to MU from context. Energy (XOM) and utilities (SO, DUK) rejections noted as surprises, no call. XBI/LABD and V/MA mentioned positively but briefly.
